known_limitations: Public first-day monthly samples are a fatal discovery screen, not a full-calendar performance estimate.
No candidate approached the preregistered 20-trade minimum; parameter polishing cannot establish a repeatable edge.
The strongest causal path depended on one ETH winner and one BTC loss across two dates.
Funding is immaterial on the tested sub-30-second horizon but full Bybit production execution was not opened.

strategy_explanation.entry_invalidation: No entry after the linear contract reprices through more than half the gap, target/leader spread limits fail, or modeled full-fill impact breaches the marketable-limit price.
strategy_explanation.smc_ict: The Bybit inverse perpetual makes a completed displacement while the USDT-linear perpetual fails to confirm, producing a measurable inter-contract SMT divergence and prior-basis-adjusted fair-value imbalance. The linear contract is entered toward rebalance only while at least half of that causal imbalance remains after latency.

summary: Hard-valid Bybit inverse-to-linear perpetual executable upper-bound screen. Across 324 frozen BTCUSD/ETHUSD leader to BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT target configurations, zero fit survivors. Candidate trade count was at most six; 238 policies had zero trades. The future-information 30-second executable oracle was positive at 18bp for 28 policies, but the best summary-ranked policy had only one BTC trade (+12.8258bp oracle, -35.4177bp causal fixed-10s). Only four policies had positive mean fixed-10s return at 18bp and each had two trades, consisting of one loss and one winner on two dates. Development and 2024-2026 remained unopened. The exact inverse-linear SMT/FVG dependency is closed without exit, risk or leverage tuning.
